scope: Direct entry of already received supplier orders in the management application
workflow: Manual entry from a supplier document: supplier, product search, received quantities, optional price edits, explicit stock confirmation
changes: Add Cargar orden alongside the existing purchase creation workflow
Search active products by name, SKU or barcode, including products without stock
Show received quantity, unit cost, retail price and optional wholesale price together
Accept Argentine monetary formatting and decimal quantities without numeric input spinners
Reuse existing order, receipt and inventory movement logic in one transaction
Prevent duplicate stock entries on concurrent or repeated submissions
Keep unedited catalog prices intact and reject conflicting concurrent price edits
Preserve the draft after errors and offer an explicit reload of current prices
Revalidate product, purchase, sales and storefront views after a successful receipt

database.security: SECURITY INVOKER, active organization membership, existing RLS, authenticated execution only
database.idempotency: Client request UUID, transaction advisory lock and immutable request payload ledger
database.priceConflict: HTTP 409 business conflict; never SQLSTATE 40001 transaction retry
database.productionCatalogCacheWarning: CLI catalog caching timed out after the migration completed; migration history, function privileges and production integrity were verified independently

verification.deviceTesting: Desktop Chrome and responsive emulation, not physical devices
checks: Owner and staff can record a received purchase
Decimal quantity 2.5 and cost 10500.95 are saved correctly
Edited retail prices appear in sales and the public storefront
Conflicting price changes roll back without losing the draft
Concurrent retries return the same order and increment stock once
The existing create, send and receive purchase flow remains functional
No horizontal overflow or serious/critical accessibility violations in tested views
Existing sales, combined expenses, payroll, scanner and e-commerce regressions pass
verification.finalServerAdjustment: Reran the production build after batching current-price reads for long orders; repeated the full database, browser flow and responsive page regression against that build
testHarnessFixes: Select canonical fixtures explicitly rather than relying on catalog ordering or the first product page
Wait for the authenticated storefront header before navigating after login, and observe cart quantities before checkout
